title: Code of Virginia, Title 58.1 (Taxation), Chapter 3 (Income Tax), Article 16 - Income Tax Withholding
source_id: Va. Code ss 58.1-460 through 58.1-486 (tit. 58.1, ch. 3, art. 16)
verified_how: fetched https://law.lis.virginia.gov/vacode/title58.1/chapter3/ (HTTP 200): chapter heading 'Chapter 3. Income Tax' with article heading 'Article 16. Income Tax Withholding' listing s 58.1-460 (Definitions), 58.1-461 (Requirement of withholding), 58.1-462 (Withholding tables), 58.1-463 (Other methods of withholding), 58.1-464 through 58.1-481 (Withheld taxes not deductible in computing taxable income), 58.1-482, 58.1-483, 58.1-484 (Liability of employer for payment of tax required to be withheld), 58.1-485, 58.1-485.1 and 58.1-486 (Bad checks) - none marked 'Repealed' or '(Effective ...)'. Currency: the register's own 2026 Updates page (https://law.lis.virginia.gov/vacodeupdates/) states 'this is a list of updated sections that took effect on July 1, 2026, unless otherwise noted', so the online Code reflects the 2026 session. The site marks future text as '(Effective <date>)' and dead text as 'Repealed', and the cited provisions carry neither marker. Note that article-level URLs such as /vacode/title40.1/chapter3/article2/ return HTTP 200 with an EMPTY content pane, so the citable register page for an article is its chapter page, which prints the article heading and its section list.
notes: The substantive individual income tax is Article 2 of the same chapter (Individual Income Tax); Article 16 is the withholding machinery. Article 16.1 (ss 58.1-486.1 to 58.1-486.3) covers withholding by pass-through entities.
